item.title: The software manual inside Schrödinger's Flex
item.description:
Line-by-line on Schrödinger's Flex. The cat was a joke at people who scale quantum to a cat. Compute it or pipe down. Cosplay cosmos vs a functional manual. LocalFlow, DAG, did:key, XP = R × F × delta S × (w E) × log(1/Tₛ). Then the branch where he quit.

item.title: Homelessness is a signal loss crisis
item.description: NotebookLM deep dive on And That. Homelessness is not a housing shortage - it is what happens when every feedback loop goes deaf. Cash on symptoms, dodge causation. You cannot patch a soul with a voucher and a mat. DAG of verified delta S, XP as access not a cash-out. You cannot house a person back into a name.

item.title: Mapping human interactions to entropy reduction
item.description: A NotebookLM debate on the Extropy Engine. Is mapping human work onto verified delta S - via a local DAG, no fiat on-ramp, and a proxy that gets less wrong as the graph fills - a rigorous answer to broken rewards, or a category error that measures the exhaust of a ride instead of the reason for it? Codex v2.1, the mint formula, LocalFlow, DFAO scale, standing unbundled from XP.
